notes:
Why attempt 1 failed to compile:
- The error is not in this file. It is in PcdetlService.java:106, the PCDETL port, which is outside this ticket and which I may not edit (rule 6).
- That line calls task.sendMap(map, mapset, screen, null, ...). A bare null fits both sendMap(..., MapSubfields, String...) and sendMap(..., String...), so the call is ambiguous.
- One-line fix for the PCDETL port: pass `new CicsTask.MapSubfields()`, or cast the null to `(CicsTask.MapSubfields) null`.
- PcmenuService passes a typed MapSubfields variable, so it compiles on its own. The three scenarios need PcdetlService fixed before they can run.

Defects of the original, kept:
- MOVE DFHCOMMAREA TO WS-CA always moves 10 bytes, even when EIBCALEN < 10. Fix: INITIALIZE WS-CA, then MOVE DFHCOMMAREA(1:EIBCALEN).
- ADD 1 TO MN-VISITS has no ON SIZE ERROR, so 9999 wraps to 0000. Fix: add ON SIZE ERROR, or widen the PICTURE.
- The RECEIVE MAP has no RESP and no HANDLE CONDITION MAPFAIL. A key that sends no data abends AEI9, except PF3 and PF5, whose HANDLE AID takes precedence. Fix: add RESP to the RECEIVE and treat MAPFAIL like 'KEY NOT ACTIVE'.
- The XCTL has no RESP. A PGMIDERR or LENGERR takes CICS's default action, an abend. Fix: add RESP and show an error on the menu.
- MENU-EXIT follows END-EVALUATE with no exit in between. Every EVALUATE branch ends the task (XCTL, RETURN or SHOW-MENU), so the fall-through is never taken. It is kept as is.
- EIBCALEN = 0 always starts a new session, even for PF3, so PF3 on a new session does not exit. This is by design, as the source says.

Facts:
- No fact was contradicted by the source.
- For the PC12 RETURN and the XCTL, the COMMAREA is passed as PcdetlWsCa, because PCDETL reads that DTO.
- On entry, a COMMAREA of either PcmenuWsCa or PcdetlWsCa is accepted. PCDETL's RETURN TRANSID('PC11') at src/PCDETL.cbl:35 may pass the same 10-byte layout under its own DTO.
